name: General prohibition / restriction
legal_question: Does the law restrict cross-border transfer of personal data as a default?

name: Adequacy standard
legal_question: Can data be transferred to countries deemed to have adequate protection?

name: Contractual safeguards
legal_question: Are standard contractual clauses or BCRs accepted as transfer mechanisms?

name: Consent exception
legal_question: Can transfer proceed with individual consent?

name: Other exceptions
legal_question: What other lawful bases permit cross-border transfer (vital interests, public interest)?

name: Legal basis for processing
legal_question: Does the law require a lawful basis for collecting/processing personal data?

name: Purpose limitation
legal_question: Is data restricted to the purpose for which it was collected?

name: Data subject rights
legal_question: Do individuals have rights to access, correct, or delete their data?

name: Data breach notification
legal_question: Is there a mandatory data breach notification requirement?

name: Enforcement and penalties
legal_question: Is there a supervisory authority and penalty regime?
